name: Edgewood
seo_title: Edgewood Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 4 Events, 2 Free
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Edgewood, New Mexico for 2026: 4 family events, 2 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
lede: Edgewood keeps Christmas at Venus Park on NM 344, with a parade and tree lighting, a balloon glow and a library craft morning, and the East Mountains area adds the Luminaria de Abo near Mountainair.
celebrates: The Town of Edgewood lists its holiday season on its Town events page. The Twinkle Light Parade and Tree Lighting is at 6 pm on NM Route 344 and at Venus Park, 181 NM-344, and the Town schedules a Santa Run at Venus Park on December 12. The Edgewood Community Library, 171B NM-344, hosts Ornament Decorating with supplies provided. The Holiday Balloon Glow at Venus Park closes the Town's December run. South of Edgewood, Salinas Pueblo Missions National Monument holds the Luminaria de Abo, which we fold into this page because Mountainair has too few events for its own page.
lastyear: We did not find a host recap of Edgewood's 2025 Christmas events, so this page does not repeat dates or crowds from last year. The Town of Edgewood's events page and the Edgewood Community Library's own program pages are the host sources linked on each event listing, and they give the 2026 date, time and place. Check them again close to the day, since small town listings can change. Salinas Pueblo Missions publishes its own Luminaria de Abo page with parking and shuttle details.
facts: Edgewood sits in the East Mountains east of Albuquerque, and its Town events run along NM Route 344, where Venus Park and the Edgewood Community Library both have addresses. The Luminaria de Abo lights more than 1,000 luminarias at the Ancestral Pueblo and the 17th century Abo mission church, according to the National Park Service. Parking for it is in Mountainair, with free shuttles from the Mountainair Headquarters Visitor Center at 105 South Ripley Avenue starting at 4:30 pm.
trains: Edgewood has no train station and we could not verify a Christmas train ride on a host page for the East Mountains. For railroad history, the Wheels Museum in Albuquerque and the New Mexico Steam Locomotive and Railroad Historical Society, also in Albuquerque, are the nearest verified museum pages on our site. Check each museum's own site for holiday hours. Our Albuquerque guide covers the Trolley of Lights and other rides.

traditions: A Friday evening parade on NM 344 that ends with a tree lighting at Venus Park.
The Town schedules a Santa Run at Venus Park the same Saturday as the library craft.

kidfact: A luminaria is a candle set in sand inside a paper bag, and a thousand of them together make a whole mission church glow.
faq: Where are Edgewood's Christmas events held?

Most are at Venus Park, 181 NM-344, including the Twinkle Light Parade and Tree Lighting, the Santa Run and the Balloon Glow. The library craft is at the Edgewood Community Library, 171B NM-344. The Luminaria de Abo is farther south, with parking and shuttles in Mountainair.
Is the Twinkle Light Parade free?

Yes. It is a public community parade, so watching is free. The Town's event page lists the start at 6 pm and the contact phone 505-286-4518. Check the page for parade registration and any added activities before you go, since the listing is short.
Do I need a ticket for the Luminaria de Abo?

The National Park Service says no ticket or reservation is needed for the shuttle. All parking is in the Town of Mountainair and free shuttle buses leave from the Mountainair Headquarters Visitor Center. Pets are not allowed on the shuttles.

The Edgewood Community Library says it offers free, community centered programs, and the Ornament Decorating event lists all supplies as provided. The event page does not list an age range, so call the library at (505) 281-2400 to confirm.
Is there a Christmas Eve service in Edgewood?
We do not have a Christmas Eve services page for Edgewood. Albuquerque has one, and it lists services across the Albuquerque area.
